## Content review

### Scope

- Article(s):
- Mode: research / brief / draft / implementation / QA
- Publication authorized: no

### Review gates

- [ ] Matches an approved topic and does not duplicate an existing page
- [ ] Follows `content-system/editorial-rules.md`
- [ ] Contains no medical, exercise, or nutrition advice
- [ ] Contains none of the prohibited public terms
- [ ] Material claims are traceable to the research ledger
- [ ] Volumes Lab process claims are confirmed by project evidence
- [ ] Product names and internal links match the catalogue
- [ ] Client has reviewed every word
- [ ] Qualified professional review is complete where required
- [ ] Rich-text rendering and metadata are verified before publication

### Validation

- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Lint
- [ ] Build
- [ ] Desktop review
- [ ] Mobile review
